verdict.rationale: Box can be driven entirely headlessly through its REST API with OAuth 2.0 bearer tokens, including a scriptable curl example. Box also documents a CLI for giving AI agents access to content and a way to mount Box folders into agent runtimes as a synced POSIX filesystem. Event feeds and webhooks support event-driven automation without a UI. missing for 10: explicit CI/CD pipeline guidance, documented non-interactive server-to-server auth for unattended runs (only OAuth and short-lived developer tokens are shown), detailed Box CLI docs, independent hands-on corroboration of CI usage.
